z6_reading.origin: simulation side, corrected by the theory session on 2026-11-10
z6_reading.statement: a flux of class k gives a component of hypercharge label Q6 the phase exp(2 pi i k Q6 / 6). Each class k equals the centre class 6Y mod 6 of Standard Model multiplets, exact on all 32 patterns, and the defect is the flux boson of its class: class 3 is the weak centre, classes 2 and 4 the colour centre, classes 1 and 5 generate.
z6_reading.status: the class match is derived; the register rule of the runs is declared

groups.label: Quarks
groups.blurb: spin 1/2 · three colours · feel the strong force

groups.label: Neutrinos
groups.blurb: spin 1/2 · neutral · only the weak force

groups.label: Gluons
groups.blurb: spin 1 · carry the strong force · eight colour states

groups.label: W and Z bosons
groups.blurb: spin 1 · carry the weak force · massive

groups.label: Higgs boson
groups.blurb: spin 0 · gives mass in the Standard Model

1.label: left-handed quark class
1.detail: class 1: colour and weak charge. As a flux: seen by every quark pattern and by the lepton doublet

5.label: left-handed antiquark class
5.detail: class 5, the conjugate of class 1: annihilates with it

4.label: right-handed quark class
4.detail: class 4: colour charge only. As a flux: the centre of the colour group, seen by quark patterns only

3.label: lepton doublet and Higgs class
3.detail: class 3: weak charge only; its own conjugate class; the Higgs has the same class. As a flux: the sign of a link

families.label: Family A: centre flux 1 and its conjugate 5 · they generate the centre
families.note: classes 1 and 5 are conjugates; a pair is born from two flat faces and annihilates on contact. Seen by every quark pattern and every weak doublet

families.label: Family B: colour-centre flux 2 and its conjugate 4
families.note: classes 2 and 4 are conjugates; produced directly by a contrast of 4 or 5, or by fusion of two class-1 fluxes. Seen by quark patterns only

families.label: Family C: weak-centre flux 3
families.note: class 3 is its own conjugate; produced directly by a contrast of 5, or by fusion of classes 1 and 2. Seen by weak doublets only
